subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & Audit Logs — Next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lisa Park <lisa.park@acme.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: SOC 2 & Audit Logs — Next steps

Hi Lisa — great to meet earlier. Quick recap and next steps from our call with the Acme security team: 

Summary of pain points you shared:
- Need SOC 2 Type II evidence and summary artifacts for vendor onboarding
- Clarification on audit log capture, retention, and export (S3 versus in-product)
- DPA and data retention terms (HIPAA/backup retention concerns)
- Evidence of recent pen test & remediation timeline

How Redwood can help / what we agreed:
- We will provide our latest SOC 2 Type II report, pen-test summary, and a sample export of audit logs (7-day window)
- DPA draft attached for your legal review; we can negotiate retention and deletion clauses specific to Acme
- We can enable read-only access to a dedicated audit-log export for your compliance team (scoped, time-limited)

Immediate next steps (action items):
1) Marissa: Send SOC 2 report, pen test summary, DPA draft, and a sample audit-log export (attached) — by EOD today.
2) Lisa / Acme: Confirm which stakeholder should receive the DocuSign DPA and any redlines (security@acme.com recommended).
3) Schedule a 30-min follow-up with Acme security to walk through the audit logs and retention settings — proposed slots below.

Proposed follow-up slots (PDT):
- Thu 20 May, 9:00–9:30am
- Thu 20 May, 1:00–1:30pm
- Fri 21 May, 10:00–10:30am

Attachments in this thread: Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (redacted), pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (summary), DPA_Draft_Acme_Redwood.pdf, audit-log-sample-7days.json

If anything above is missing or you want the full pen-test report (we typically provide an executive summary and a scoped partner copy), let me know and I’ll coordinate.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com | (415) 555-0142

From: Lisa Park <lisa.park@acme.com>

Cc: AcmeCorp Security <security@acme.com>, John Doe <john.doe@acme.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & Audit Logs — Next steps

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. A few clarifying asks from our security team: 

1) Can you confirm the scope & dates of the SOC 2 report (period covered and whether encryption at rest is covered)?
2) For the pen-test summary, we need to understand whether there were any critical findings and whether remediation is completed — an exec summary is fine.
3) Audit logs: please confirm what fields are captured (user identity, IP, request path, timestamp, request payload truncated) and the default retention policy. We also need an export format (CSV/JSON) and whether exports can be delivered to our S3.
4) DPA: please send the DPA to security@acme.com and include any options for retention/deletion clauses.

We’d like to schedule the follow-up with our security lead — John Doe is on this thread. Thu 20 May 1pm PDT works for us.

Appreciate the artifacts today.
—Lisa
Lisa Park
Director, Security Operations | Acme Corp
lisa.park@acme.com

Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 16:50:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: SOC 2 & Audit Logs — Next steps

Hi Lisa / John / Acme security — attaching the artifacts we discussed. See notes inline below and attachments.

1) SOC 2 Type II report (Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf) — covers period 2026-01-01 through 2026-12-31. Scope: security & availability; encryption at rest is documented in control A.3.4. Executive summary included. For a full unredacted copy we can execute an NDA and provide the auditor's letter.

2) Pen test summary (pen_test_summary_2026.pdf) — executive summary only. There were no critical findings; two high findings were remediated in Q1 2027 (CVE-2026-xxxx and an auth config issue). Full remediation notes included. If Acme needs the full pentest report, we can provide under an evidence access agreement.

3) Audit logs (audit-log-sample-7days.json) — attached sample includes: timestamp, user.email, actor_ip, action, resource_path, request_id. Default retention: 90 days hot retention in the product; 7 years of archived logs retained in cold storage (WORM available on request). Exports: JSON/NDJSON or CSV; we can set up automated S3 delivery to a customer bucket (we support cross-account S3 uploads via role).

4) DPA (DPA_Draft_Acme_Redwood.pdf) — draft attached. Key negotiable items called out on page 3: data retention, subprocessors list, and incident notification SLA. We can route the DocuSign link to security@acme.com — see link below.

Attachments included:
- Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf (redacted)
- pen_test_summary_2026.pdf (exec summary)
- DPA_Draft_Acme_Redwood.pdf
- audit-log-sample-7days.json (sample export)

Next steps:
- Confirm DocuSign recipient (security@acme.com) and any redlines on the DPA — Marissa to route.
- Follow-up call Thu 20 May 1:00pm PDT — confirmed.
- If John or the team wants a scoped sandbox for direct log inspection, we can provision read-only export access for 48 hours — please confirm scope.

If you need anything else for procurement, ping me and I’ll loop our legal and SRE contacts.

Thanks — Marissa

--
